bioconda.name: popqc
bioconda.summary: A population-level quality control and outlier detection tool for large cohort genomics datasets.
bioconda.description: PopQC is a fast, scalable QC reporting tool that generates interactive HTML reports for quality control analysis of large cohort genomics datasets. It can process QC logs from any genomics workflow including RNA-seq, WGS, WES, variant calling, single-cell, long-read sequencing, and more.
